events.description: Called with a view's id when it is chosen, after `onQueryChange` has its query.
events.name: onViewChange

events.description: Called with the whole next query each time the user changes any part of it.
events.name: onQueryChange

props.description: The facets, in the order the panel lists them; `id`s are unique in the list.
props.name: filters

props.description: The panel's heading and accessible name, for example "Filter products".
props.name: label

props.description: How many records each option of a choice facet would match, by filter `id` then option `id`.
props.name: counts

props.description: How many records the query matches; it rolls to its new value when it changes.
props.name: resultCount

props.description: The saved views, drawn as tabs above the chips; choosing one applies its whole query.
props.name: views

props.description: The id of the view in force; left out, the first view is shown as chosen.
props.name: activeViewId

props.description: The columns the sort menu offers; left out or empty, there is no sort menu.
props.name: sortOptions

props.description: The query in force: the search text, the applied filters and the sort.
props.name: query

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
